name: Lacquer the Sleek Black Cat
blurb: Lacquer, a sleek jet-black shorthair with a mirror-glossy coat and bright gold eyes, sits tall on the garden gatepost to greet each visitor.

name: Magpie the Tuxedo Cat
blurb: Magpie, a trim black-and-white tuxedo cat with a crisp white bib and four white socks, tidies fallen leaves along the stepping stones.

name: Satchel the Ghost-Stripe Cat
blurb: Satchel, a glossy black cat whose faint ghost stripes show only in bright sun, naps in every empty delivery box left beside the garden shed.
